_why_two_claims: AGREEMENT asks whether the engines compute the same thing; RECOVERY asks whether they compute the right thing. Neither implies the other.

truth.source: the fixture's data-generating process: AUCs Phi(1.2/sqrt 2) and Phi(0.7/sqrt 2); sensitivities at 0.6 Phi(0.6) and Phi(0.1)

agreement.claim: both engines report the same AUCs, paired and unpaired SEs, DeLong z, sensitivities and McNemar statistic
agreement._note: Observed spread on the committed fixture: 0; Python's paired z equals pROC's roc.test statistic. harness/diagnostic_examples.test.py checks McNemar's statistic equals (b - c)^2 / (b + c) and that the paired SE is below the unpaired one in every seed.

recovery.claim: the estimates are close to the fixture's

calibration.rule: about 1.3 times the measured 99th percentile miss, rounded up
calibration.limits: A first fixture (800 patients, thresholds at each marker's midpoint) had a sensitivity difference of 0.089 and a miss of 0.073, which could not separate it from zero; the fixture uses 2,000 patients and a common threshold. Measured by harness/diagnostic_examples.test.py over seeds 0 to 99 (MALLARD_SEEDS=100); CI reruns it on seeds 0 to 49 at the same order statistic.
